## Concise

+ Public Welfare: The server only accepts unsolicited donations and will run for as long as possible. Even if things don’t go as planned, we will continue to maintain this project. When it ends, perhaps it will be the beginning of another cycle.

+ Purity: The interface is simple and refined, minimizing information output. Some original features are preserved without breaking game balance. Player feedback is welcome to help us improve the server.

## Complete

+ Integrity: No essential features are missing. Daily backups are kept for the long term, and players’ substantive changes to the server are logged over time. A whitelist prevents griefing, and rules are set to ensure fairness.

+ Hardcore: Achieve perfect results in the simplest way – all features remain concise. The server will host more projects over time, and we are also experimenting with innovations or developing more potentially useful features.

---

The server has a whitelist enabled, but you can visit our server:
- Address: `visit.ipacel.cc`
- Web map: https://dynmap.ipacel.cc/
网页地图：https://dynmap.ipacel.cc/

This is a Chinese community. If you'd like to join us, please ensure you have at least:
- An email address or a premium (Mojang/Microsoft) account
- A QQ account: we communicate via Tencent QQ
